name: MACS J0416.1-2403 bridge field (Hubble)
blurb: A field on the outskirts of the galaxy cluster MACS J0416.1-2403, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj041612403-hubble
story: This pointing bridges the gap between the cluster's core and a neighboring Hubble field. Here astronomers traced intracluster light, the faint glow of stars stripped from their galaxies and drifting freely through the cluster.

claims.text: MACS J0416.1-2403 is a galaxy cluster studied by the Hubble Frontier Fields programme
The bridge fields lie in the gap between each Frontier Field cluster's primary field and its parallel field, extending coverage outward
The program maps intracluster light around the Frontier Field clusters
Intracluster light comes from stars stripped from their galaxies that float freely within the cluster
The cluster is also written MCS J0416.1-2403
